title: Print Guard
summary: Before printing, finds what the paper will lose (dropped backgrounds, collapsed sections, cut-off tables) and fixes it for print only.
description: Pre-print check that finds light-on-dark text the browser drops, collapsed sections, tables wider than the page, scroll boxes that print only what's visible and links without addresses, with print-only fixes; since Ctrl+P can't be stopped, autoFix applies them too.
catches: Light text on dark backgrounds the browser won't print
Collapsed sections that would print closed
Tables wider than the printable width
Scroll boxes that print only the visible part
limits: Default page width is A4 with 1 cm margins; set pageWidth for Letter or other sizes
Can't change the browser's own print settings (backgrounds, scale)
Checks the live DOM at print time; content loaded later is missed
a11y: Toggle uses aria-expanded; the panel is a labelled region, inert when closed
Status uses role=status; focus moves into the panel and back to Print
Highlight motion is skipped under reduced motion
